name: Avatar
intent: Photo or initials for one person. Not a status chip and not a button.
usage: Always pass name. src is optional: a missing or broken photo falls back to initials from the name. A person icon shows only if there are no initials either. See contracts/avatar.json for the full contract.

name.note: Full name. Used for alt text and initials.

src.note: Photo URL. Cropped to the shape.

initials.note: Overrides the initials from name. Two letters max.

size.note: 24 / 32 / 40 / 48 px. xs is the table row size: it keeps a person cell inside a 36 / 40 px row.

decorative.note: The person's name is already written next to the avatar, like in a table cell or a list row, so screen readers skip the picture instead of reading the name twice.

doNot: Do not invent a local Avatar.
Do not use for status or category labels.
Do not make Avatar clickable. Wrap it in a Button or link only with a new contract.
Do not put a status dot or count on Avatar.
Do not mix circle and square in the same list.
Do not use for logos or brands. Use Logo.
a11y: With a photo, the img alt is the name (empty when decorative).
Without a photo, the circle is role=img with aria-label set to the name; decorative hides it from screen readers instead.
The fallback person icon is decorative.

examples.title: Photo
examples.usage: Photo avatars in xs, sm, md and lg. The photo is cropped to the circle.

examples.title: Initials
examples.usage: Leave out src to show initials. Two or more words use the first and last letters (Boris Jovanovic becomes BJ). One word uses its first two letters (Mira becomes MI).

examples.title: Broken photo
examples.usage: If the photo fails to load, the Avatar shows initials instead. Nothing breaks on the screen.

examples.title: Square
examples.usage: Square with small rounded corners. Same sizes, photo and initials as the circle. Use one shape per list.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.usage: xs 24px, sm 32px, md 40px, lg 48px. The same sizes apply to photos and initials. xs is the size a table cell uses, so a person row keeps its height.
